title: Conan and Heiji's Deduction Magic
notes: Case spans episodes 406-408 but only subtitle transcripts for 406 and 408 were available locally (407 is missing); both available transcripts were read in full. The gap in 407 is not narratively costly here -- 406 is entirely setup (magic show, meeting the three disciples, arrival at Masakage's house, the blackout that ends the episode) and 408 opens with a narration recap covering the discovery of Tenko's body, which was presumably shown in full in 407, so no plot beats appear to be missing from the reconstructable graph. Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Heiji Hattori, Ran, Kazuha, Inspector Megure, Takagi, Chiba) omitted by convention. The old cases/ file's culprit (Dogo Hoshikawa) is confirmed correct by the transcript, and its basic motive sketch (recognizing his mentor's stolen, unperformed trick) holds up -- but it omitted the actual mechanism of the case entirely: the murder was solvable only via a twin-room mirror-door illusion Masakage built into the house, which Hoshikawa exploited to fake an outside intruder, and Mari Masakage's fabricated-visitor story (modeled on Handa's real appearance/habits) that was covering for Hoshikawa rather than accusing anyone real. Those details, the murder weapon (a vase), and the staged-intruder evidence are added here from the transcript. Kazumi Sanada and other magicians mentioned only in passing dialogue (unrelated to this case's crime, referencing other episodes/cases) are omitted as not case-relevant. case_type: murder.

clues.desc: The vase's shadow fell away from the moonlight on the first hallway visit but sideways to it after the blackout -- two different vases in two different rooms, exposing the mirror-door illusion.
Tenko's proposed 'resurrection of the witch' trick is identical in idea and staging to Masakage's secret, unperformed 'resurrection of the wizard' -- proof she'd seen the stolen notebook.
The fictitious visitor Mari described pushed up his sunglasses with his left pinky, a habit an old photo shows is actually Handa's -- proof Mari invented the visitor.
